text: We will meet tomorrow afternoon. Please bring the revised plan so we can review it together.
meaning: Meet tomorrow afternoon; bring the revised plan for a joint review.

text: The deployment is complete, but we must keep the backup. If the API is slow, roll back the update.
meaning: Deployment completed; retain the backup; rollback is conditional on a slow API.

text: 내일 오후에 만나겠습니다. 수정된 계획서를 가져오고 내용을 함께 확인해 주세요.
meaning: Meet tomorrow afternoon; bring the revised plan and review its contents together.

text: 배포는 끝났지만 백업은 유지해야 합니다. API의 응답이 느리면 업데이트를 되돌려 주세요.
meaning: Deployment completed; retain the backup; rollback is conditional on a slow API.
